title: For each course offered in the 2007 academic year by a degree-granting depa
question: For each course offered in the 2007 academic year by a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering, except for the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, display the course key, course name, department name, the number of catalog subjects and the total units for those subjects, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments). Additionally, for each course, show the full department name and the school code. The results should be ordered by department name and course name. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH eng_depts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT
  WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
    AND IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
),
catalog AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN eng_depts e ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007'
),
qualifying_subjects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM catalog c
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s
    ON s.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
   AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
    AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_units,
    VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_units
  FROM catalog c
  JOIN qualifying_subjects q
    ON q.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
   AND q.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_ID AS course_key,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_catalog_subjects,
  SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units,
  d.avg_units,
  d.range_units,
  d.var_units,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS full_department_name,
  sd.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code
FROM catalog c
JOIN dept_stats d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  c.SUBJECT_ID,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  d.avg_units,
  d.range_units,
  d.var_units,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,

ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE
